receipt.name: WarmClockwise
receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA8 raster rotated clockwise into an independent owned 259x513 raster at the same depth. Complete public Rotate(Clockwise90), admission, allocation, materialization and disposal. Native public FFmpeg transpose graph allocates/processes independent pixels and releases output inside every operation. Graph/source/frame wrappers are reused. Native padded rows exposed directly; no redundant packing/materialization copy. Exact clockwise placement, alpha and hidden RGB; no output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this original raster is measured.
